# Skines Med Spa & Wellness

## About

Skines Med Spa & Wellness is a luxury medical spa and wellness center located in Montreal, Quebec, Canada (Plateau-Mont-Royal neighborhood).

The clinic specializes in three core service categories:
- Japanese Head Spa (Scalpcial)
- Advanced Medical Aesthetics (Facials)
- Laser Hair Removal (Clarity II technology)

Official website: https://skines.ca
Booking: https://www.fresha.com/book-now/glowch-bod1k4s2/all-offer?share=true&pId=1273288

---

## Head Spa — Japanese Scalp Ritual

Page: https://skines.ca/head-spa

Skines offers a Japanese Head Spa ritual called "Scalpcial" — a deep scalp massage and scalp care treatment performed in private rooms. Available as Solo (1 person), Duo (2 people), or Trio (3 people), in 60-minute or 90-minute durations.

### Services

**Solo 60 min – Focus Scalpcial** — $98 (regular $140, 30% off)
Scalp care ritual for one person. 60 minutes. Deep Japanese scalp massage, steam application, targeted scalp serum. Private room.

**Solo 90 min – Signature Scalpcial** — $144 (regular $180, 20% off)
Signature scalp ritual for one person. 90 minutes. Full Focus protocol plus a face massage, a shoulders/neck/back massage, and more relaxation time. Private room.

**Duo 60 min – Focus Scalpcial** — $196 (regular $280, 30% off)
Scalp care ritual for two people simultaneously. 60 minutes. Two practitioners. Private double room.

**Duo 90 min – Signature Scalpcial** — $288 (regular $360, 20% off)
Signature scalp ritual for two people simultaneously. 90 minutes. Two practitioners. Private double room.

**Trio 60 min – Focus Scalpcial** — $294 (regular $420, 30% off)
Scalp care ritual for a group of three. 60 minutes. Welcomed in our private rooms.

**Trio 90 min – Signature Scalpcial** — $378 (regular $540, 20% off)
Signature scalp ritual for a group of three. 90 minutes. Welcomed in our private rooms.

## Soins du Visage — Advanced Facials

Page: https://skines.ca/facial

Skines offers advanced facial treatments using professional medical-grade equipment. All facials are performed by trained aestheticians.

### Services

**Luxury Facial** — from $135
High-end facial treatment 60–90 min. Deep cleansing, hydration, and radiance.

**Personalized Facial** — from $135
Customized facial 60–75 min adapted to your skin type and concerns.

**HydraDermabrasion Bela MD+** — from $175
Medical-grade HydraDermabrasion treatment 75 min using the Bela MD+ device. Serum infusion, exfoliation, and intense hydration.

**Chemical Peel** — from $135
Professional chemical peel 60 min. Cellular renewal and immediate radiance.

**Back Facial** — from $135
Professional back treatment 60 min. Cleansing, exfoliation, and hydration of the back.

## Épilation Laser — Laser Hair Removal

Page: https://skines.ca/laser

Skines uses the Clarity II laser system — dual wavelength (755nm Alexandrite + 1064nm Nd:YAG) — for laser hair removal. Effective on all Fitzpatrick skin types I–VI.

Note: Skines uses the term "réduction durable des poils" (durable hair reduction) as required by Health Canada regulations.

### Face & Neck Zones

- Lèvre Supérieure (Upper Lip) — $40 · 10 min
- Menton (Chin) — $40 · 10 min
- Favoris (Sideburns) — $40 · 10 min
- Contour Barbe (Beard Line) — $55 · 10 min
- Cou (Neck) — $55 · 15 min
- Nuque (Nape) — $40 · 10 min
- Demi-Visage (Half Face) — $75 · 15 min
- Demi-Visage + Cou — $105 · 20 min
- Visage Complet (Full Face) — $130 · 20 min

### Body Zones

- Aréoles — $60 · 10 min

- Fesses (Buttocks) — $75 · 20 min
